purpose: Public development qualification of a bounded runtime comparison path
opening_accounts: Explicit per case; all account identities and owners must be observed
amount_input: Unsigned plain decimal string; 1-9 integer digits and up to 4 fractional digits; round once to cents using half-even; rounded amount must be positive
amount_observation: Exact nonnegative integer cents or a plain decimal string representing exact cents; sub-cent observations are never rounded
date: Valid exact YYYY-MM-DD business date; no clock or time-zone normalization
authorization: Actor must own the source account; recipient may have a different owner
idempotency: Successful request id binds source, recipient, rounded cents, business date and actor; same payload replays without effect; changed payload conflicts without effect
rejections: Invalid amount/date/account, same-account transfers, unauthorized actor and insufficient funds leave all balances and the committed-operation registry unchanged
atomicity: A process exit at the declared precommit crash hook leaves no committed debit, credit or operation; replay after recovery applies exactly once
concurrency: In-process concurrent workers, with sufficient funds for every operation; all effects persist; outcomes and operation registries are unordered identity-keyed sets
restart: Every command is a fresh OS process using the same per-case persisted state directory
observation: Full account inventory with ownership, committed-operation registry and every command outcome; collection ordering is not semantic; duplicates are rejected
acceptance_for_public_development_campai: All declared correct cases pass on both implementations, every seeded fault has a raw witness and a failed comparison, all normalization/admission challenges pass, and the no-trigger control remains not-exercised
reused_assets: CloudBank MS66 transfer, negative-path, concurrency and restart scenario concepts
lightyear_common.io logical hashing and JSON output
existing_gate_relationship: This is a new bounded observation comparator under challenge. It does not requalify the existing CardDemo or CloudBank comparators, nor change their receipts or normalization ledgers.
